observation.command: echo "=== web_application .env.local (redacted) ==="; cat /workspace/web_application/.env.local 2>&1 | sed -E 's/(TOKEN=).*/\1[REDACTED]/; s/(SECRET=).*/\1[REDACTED]/'; echo; echo "=== .env.local.example ==="; cat /workspace/web_application/.env.local.example 2>&1
